brief: Remove white space from the end
description: Remove white space and line terminators as ECMAScript counts them (tab, vertical tab, form feed, space, no-break space, U+FEFF, every Unicode space separator, LF, CR, U+2028 and U+2029) from the end of the <dataType> value, as ECMAScript s.trimEnd() does. The result is a string.

returns.description: The value without trailing white space, as a string.
